manaNeeded: {2} plus enough mana to activate the Licid's ability
easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to activate the Licid's ability.
description:
Activate Hyrax Tower Scout using the Licid's ability by paying its activation cost, attaching Hyrax Tower Scout to Yenna and causing Hyrax Tower Scout to become an Aura.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Hyrax Tower Scout.
When the Hyrax Tower Scout token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Hyrax Tower Scout token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.
